column1: # Open alias registry for entity_candidates.py. Hand-editable, one row per spelling.
# It does NOT define the topic list: new candidates are still discovered from the corpus
# without a row here. A row only links a spelling to an already-found candidate.
#   surface    exact word or phrase, matched as a whole word after NFKC+casefold (no prefix match)
#   candidate  target candidate key; "-" for not_entity_head rows
#   relation   ru_form          Russian spelling/inflection of a name
#              asset_symbol     project/network <-> asset ticker; reported as related, never merged
#              not_entity_head  word that heads phrases but is not an entity (CEO Nvidia -> nvidia)
#   basis      why the row exists; "corpus: <link>" = seen and checked in this snapshot
#   status     confirmed  -> mention counted for the candidate
#              ambiguous  -> kept as a separate ambiguous mention, never merged automatically
#   condition  for ambiguous rows: reject=<regex>; support=<regex>. Checked in a +-60 char window.
#              reject -> mention stored as rejected; support -> stored as ambiguous with a hint.
# Forms below are the ones present in astrafeed.db on 2026-09-23; add more as they appear.

column4: role: "CEO Nvidia" names Nvidia, not a CEO entity
